changes.comment: Breaking: `SESSION_SECRET`, `SESSION_TTL_HOURS` and `SESSION_IDLE_HOURS` are now `MICA_SESSION_*`; `LOGIN_MAX_ATTEMPTS` and `LOGIN_WINDOW_MS` are now `MICA_SIGNIN_MAX_ATTEMPTS` and `MICA_SIGNIN_WINDOW_MS`; `MICA_ADMIT_GROUP` and `MICA_ADMIT_DOMAIN` are now `MICA_ADMIT_GROUPS` and `MICA_ADMIT_DOMAINS`. The old names are not read.
